cards.name: Overseer's Whip
cards.text:
Surge.
Surge.While attached to an enemy, counts as a Weapon attachment with the text: `Forced: When attached enemy attacks, deal 1 damage to an exhausted character you control.When Revealed: Attach to the Easterling enemy with the lowest engagement cost.

cards.name: Arador
cards.text: Immune to player card effects.Response: After Arador is declared as a defender, ready him. (Limit once per round.)If Arador leaves play, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Weary Lands
cards.text:
Doomed 1.
When Revealed: Each exhausted character gets -1 [willpower] until the end of the phase.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Deal 1 damage to the defending character.

cards.name: Edrahil
cards.text: Immune to player card effects.Response: After Edrahil quests successfully, choose a player to draw 1 card.If Edrahil leaves play, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Cruelty of Mordor
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player deals 1 damage to a character he controls. Then, each player must choose: either deal 1 damage to each damaged character you control, or raise your threat by 1 for each damaged character you control.

cards.name: Painful Fatigue
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player exhausts a character he controls and deals 1 damage to it.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Either exhaust a character you control, or return attacking enemy to the staging area.

cards.name: Easterling Raider
cards.text:
Archery 1.
Easterling Raider gets +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] for each Easterling attachment on it.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+2 [defense] instead if it has an Easterling attachment).

cards.name: Recurve Bow
cards.text:
Surge.
While attached to an enemy, counts as a Weapon attachment with the text: `Attached enemy gains Archery 2.`When Revealed: Attach to the highest engagement cost Easterling enemy without a Recurve Bow.

cards.name: Slaves of the Dark Lord
cards.text: Setup: Add each Camp location to the staging area. Attach a random Captive objective-ally to each Camp location as a guarded objective. Place 1 random Warden enemy faceup (but not in play) under each Camp location. Shuffle the encounter deck and discard cards from the top until X locations are discarded, where X is 1 less than the number of players. Add each location discarded this way to the staging area.
cards.back_text: Setup: Add each Camp location to the staging area. Attach a random Captive objective-ally to each Camp location as a guarded objective. Place 1 random Warden enemy faceup (but not in play) under each Camp location. Shuffle the encounter deck and discard cards from the top until X locations are discarded, where X is 1 less than the number of players. Add each location discarded this way to the staging area.Each Camp location is immune to player card effects, and player cannot travel there while a Warden enemy is in play.Forced: At the end of the round, raise each player`s threat by 1 for each Camp location in the staging area.This stage cannot be defeated unless players control all 3 Captive objective-allies.

cards.name: Lead the Revolt
cards.text: When Revealed: The first player returns each Warden enemy in the victory display to the staging area. Each other player discards cards from the top of the encounter deck until he discards an enemy and adds that enemy to the staging area.
cards.back_text: When Revealed: The first player returns each Warden enemy in the victory display to the staging area. Each other player discards cards from the top of the encounter deck until he discards an enemy and adds that enemy to the staging area.This stage gets +10 quest points per player.Forced: After a player commits characters to the quest, if he is not engaged with a Warden enemy he must reveal an encounter card.This stage cannot be defeated while a Warden enemy is in play. When this stage is defeated, the players win the game.

cards.name: Lorgan
cards.text: Immune to player card effects.Only the engaged player can declare attackers or defenders against Lorgan.Forced: After Lorgan attacks, raise each player`s threat by 1 (2 instead if this attack destroys a character.

cards.name: Borlach
cards.text: Immune to player card effects.Only the engaged player can declare attackers or defenders against Borlach.Forced: After Borlach attacks and destroys a character, any excess damage must be assigned among characters you control.

cards.name: Working Fields
cards.text: While Working Fields is in the staging area, characters cannot be healed.Travel: Each player deals 1 damage to a character he controls.

cards.name: Watch Tower
cards.text: While Watch Tower is in the staging area, it gains archery X.X is 1 more than the number of Captive objective allies the players control.Travel: Reveal the top card of the encounter deck.

cards.name: The Storehouse
cards.text: Forced: After The Storehouse becomes the active location, add the enemy under it to the staging area. That enemy gets +3 [attack] and -30 engagement cost until the end of the round.Forced: When The Storehouse is explored, the first player gains control of the objective ally it was guarding.

cards.name: Nurn Slaver
cards.text: While the number of Camp locations in the staging area is less than the number of players, Nurn Slavers gains surge.

cards.name: Rocky Outcrop
cards.text: While Rocky Outcrop is in the staging area, characters cannot be readied by player card effects.Travel: The first player exhausts a hero he controls.

cards.name: Easterling Guard
cards.text:
Archery 2.
Archery 2.When Revealed: Assign X damage among characters in play. X is the current archery total.

cards.name: Farin
cards.text: Immune to player card effects.Response: After Farin is declared as an attacker against an enemy, deal 1 damage to an enemy engaged with a player.If Farin leaves play, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Broken Captives
cards.text: When Revealed: Exhaust each damaged character. If no characters are exhausted by this effect, Broken Captives gains surge and Doomed 1.

cards.name: Warrior of Rhûn
cards.text: Forced: When Warrior of Rhun attacks, attach the top Easterling treachery in the discard pile to it.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attach the top Easterling treachery in the discard pile to attacking enemy.

cards.name: Sword of Rhûn
cards.text:
Surge.
While attached to an enemy, counts as a Weapon attachment with the text: `Attached enemy gets +2 [attack].`When Revealed: Attach to the Easterling enemy with the lowest [attack] without a Sword of Rhun.

cards.name: Warriors of the East
cards.text:
Surge.
When Revealed: After an Easterling enemy enters play, attach the top Easterling treachery in the discard pile to that enemy.Forced: After Warriors of the East becomes the current quest, the highest [attack] Easterling enemy in the staging area attacks the first player.

cards.name: An Arduous Journey
cards.text: Each player cannot ready more than 6 characters he controls during the refresh phase.Response: When this stage is defeated, each player may ready a hero he controls.

cards.name: Rolling Plains
cards.text: When Revealed: Each copy of Rolling Plains gets +2 [threat] until the end of the phase.Travel: Raise each player`s threat by 2.

cards.name: Ulwarth
cards.text: Immune to player card effects.Only the engaged player can declare attackers or defenders against Ulwarth.Allies cannot be declared as attackers or defenders against Ulwarth.

cards.name: Slave Quarters
cards.text: Forced: After Slave Quarters becomes the active location, the enemy under it engages the first player and makes an immediate attack.Forced: When Slave Quarters is explored, the first player gains control of the objective ally it was guarding.

cards.name: The Barracks
cards.text: Forced: After The Barracks becomes the active location, add the enemy under it to the staging area. That enemy cannot take damage this round.Forced: When The Baracks is explored, the first player gains control of the objective ally it was guarding.
